moments.name: Initial Gateway Pattern Topology
moments.description: Introduces the foundational four-node API Gateway pattern linking api-consumer through api-gateway to api-producer and idp, then standardizes node-type classifications across all services.

commit-messages: Major refactor - migrating CALM to a specific JSON vocabulary (#15)
#74 - Updating the api-gateway.json pattern to use prefixItems (#79)
Pattern flag and fixing api-gateway pattern sample (#91)

moments.name: Typed Interfaces and FINOS Namespace
moments.description: Enriches api-gateway and api-producer with explicit interface definitions, aligns relationship wiring with Spectral validation rules, and migrates schema URIs from finos-labs to canonical finos namespaces.

commit-messages: Update API Gateway Pattern to Add Interface (#109)
Lint and insert missing properties block
Update spectral rules to use new interface format

moments.name: Direct Consumer Identity Handshake
moments.description: Adds the api-consumer-idp relationship so consumers authenticate directly against the Identity Provider before presenting tokens to api-gateway, while generalizing language-agnostic node names.

moments.name: CALM Release Schema Standardization
moments.description: Progressively upgrades interface schemas on api-gateway and api-producer from 2024-10 drafts through RC-1 candidates to stable CALM release specifications as legacy draft bundles are retired.

commit-messages: Ensure SchemaDirectory works with latest CALM draft
Update endpoints and test files related to validate/generate endpoints to use release RC-1 candidate schema (finos#1284)
fix(cli): fix test pattern to consistent use a single schema version
feat(calm-server): stop bundling the CALM 1.0 release candidates and the 2025-03 draft
